purpose: SDK-020 research ledger. A family is unavailable until its own implementation, artifact, host, live, policy, and lifecycle gates are reviewed; source names and this ledger are not support claims.

sources.evidence: Historical comparative source only; not an installed Cheat Engine 7.7 host or live qualification.

families.title: SDK-created forms and controls

owner.sdk: CE form mapping, dispatch, callback rooting, and owner facts
owner.client: Visible host-surface consent and application composition

host_prerequisites: Exact CE host build and extension-v4 slot presence
Observed UI dispatch and reentrancy behavior
A disposable SDK-created form only
privilege_requirements: Separate explicit authorization to change the CE host UI
No authority over existing CE-owned forms or controls

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: A bounded form/control description and callback admission token
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied outcome or an activation-scoped lease, never a raw CE UI pointer
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Neutralize callbacks and timers; prove child/parent and close/free behavior

failure_modes: Close that does not free the form
families.evidence_gap: Historical form construction and object_destroy behavior do not prove CE 7.7 dispatch, ownership, or callback cleanup.

implementation.requirement: Approve a narrow SDK form lifecycle contract

host.requirement: Observe exact host slots and dispatch

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove event, timer, child, and form cleanup

fixture: Validate wrapper input and stale-admission refusal
live: Create, show, close, disable, and re-enable one owned form
negative: Wrong parent, callback throw, and foreign-handler replacement

adoption_decision.reason: Create a focused issue only after the root-form lifecycle contract is approved.

families.title: Debugger state, breakpoints, and continuation

owner.sdk: Debugger interop, callback barrier, continuation disposition, and breakpoint release
owner.client: Synchronous application policy and copied observation projection

host_prerequisites: Exact debugger backend and CE build
Observed target architecture and process incarnation
A debugger-safe disposable target with a known breakpoint
privilege_requirements: Explicit debugger authorization for the named target

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: A bounded breakpoint request and synchronous disposition handler
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied event data and a documented continuation result
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Disarm, drain, neutralize callback roots, and report uncertain removal

failure_modes: Set succeeds without a provable arm
families.evidence_gap: Historical Lua and classic callback paths do not establish current callback thread, reentrancy, or safe continuation fallback.

implementation.requirement: Approve separate observation, lifecycle, and continuation contracts

host.requirement: Observe selected backend and callback execution

fixture: Native ABI width and lifetime canary
live: Set, trigger, continue, remove, disable, re-enable, and replace target
negative: Unavailable backend, duplicate address, handler throw, target exit, and detach
cleanup: Prove no callback after neutralization or stale activation

adoption_decision.reason: Debugger observation, breakpoint lifecycle, and continuation require separate contracts.

families.title: Mono collector, metadata, and symbols

owner.sdk: Collector protocol, process-scoped native handles, and callback lifetime
owner.client: Metadata workflow policy and copied result projection

host_prerequisites: Exact collector path, hash, architecture, and protocol version
Observed Mono provider module and exports
Authorized disposable Mono target
privilege_requirements: No inferred trust from runtime detection or a module filename

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Bounded discovery or metadata request tied to a collector session
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied metadata only; no pipe, collector, or runtime pointer escapes
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Detach, close pipe resources, remove callbacks, and invalidate on target exit

failure_modes: Collector injection or pipe handshake failure
families.evidence_gap: The historical Mono script and collector protocol have no current host, collector binary, export-set, or cleanup qualification.

implementation.requirement: Approve collector bootstrap separately from metadata observation

artifact.requirement: Identify collector and SDK artifact identities

host.requirement: Observe provider, protocol, and export matrix

policy.requirement: Authorize collector injection and target inspection

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove pipe, thread, and callback teardown

live: Collector handshake, bounded enumeration, detach, re-enable, and target replacement
negative: Missing DLL, wrong architecture, pipe loss, missing export, and target exit
cleanup: Prove old collector session and callbacks are inert

adoption_decision.reason: Mono bootstrap and each metadata/lookup operation need reviewed contracts.

families.title: IL2CPP discovery and symbol materialization

owner.sdk: IL2CPP collector protocol, runtime facts, and target-scoped resources

host_prerequisites: Exact collector identity and IL2CPP provider exports
Observed target identity and architecture
A disposable IL2CPP fixture

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Bounded IL2CPP discovery or symbol-materialization request
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied result or an explicitly scoped symbol-list outcome
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Cancel, clear progress/UI state, remove symbols, close collector resources

families.evidence_gap: The shared collector has no independently reviewed IL2CPP ABI, GUI-thread, SymbolList, or cancellation evidence.
dependencies: Mono collector protocol family, without inheriting its qualification

implementation.requirement: Approve IL2CPP discovery independently from Mono

artifact.requirement: Identify collector and SDK artifact identities

host.requirement: Observe IL2CPP provider exports and UI behavior

policy.requirement: Authorize collector injection and symbol creation

fixture: Bounded metadata and cancellation parser cases
live: Enumerate, cancel, remove symbols, disable, re-enable, and replace target
negative: Missing export, malformed result, target exit, and stale session
cleanup: Prove no retained collector, UI, or SymbolList state

adoption_decision.reason: IL2CPP is a distinct runtime and cannot share Mono promotion evidence.

families.title: DBVM admission and privileged operations

owner.sdk: DBVM/driver mappings, machine safety facts, and any low-level watch owner
owner.client: Operator policy, recovery choice, and workflow presentation

host_prerequisites: Dedicated recoverable VM and exact CE/DBVM/driver identities
Observed CPU virtualization and DBVM state
A separately approved machine recovery plan
privilege_requirements: No target-only authorization used for physical or MSR access

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: One named observation, initialization, watch, or privileged operation
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied factual outcome and recovery status
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Remove the exact watch/effect or record VM reset as the approved terminal recovery

families.evidence_gap: Historical DBVM source includes privileged machine operations and an unresolved classic C/Pascal load shape; it supplies no recoverable live proof.
dependencies: Machine recovery and operator authorization protocol

implementation.requirement: Approve admission separately from each privileged operation

artifact.requirement: Identify CE, driver, and DBVM artifacts

host.requirement: Observe machine, driver, and DBVM state

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove exact removal or approved VM recovery

live: Observe state before any explicit admission; record recovery outcome
negative: Unsupported CPU, denied authorization, invalid range, callback failure
cleanup: Prove watch removal or record mandatory VM reset

adoption_decision.reason: DBVM admission, watches, timing, and physical operations require separate reviews.

families.title: Speedhack host state and route variants

owner.sdk: CE speed mapping, route facts, callback registration, and cleanup reporting
owner.client: Explicit opt-in and timing workflow policy

host_prerequisites: Exact speedhack route and CE host state
Observed target identity for local route
A disposable timing fixture with a recorded baseline
privilege_requirements: Local injection, CE-server route, and callbacks separately authorized

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: A finite positive multiplier and named route
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Restore the exact baseline and report residual hooks or unknown cleanup

families.evidence_gap: Historical speed setting can drive GUI, injection, Auto Assembler, or callbacks; it does not prove per-target ownership or restore semantics.
dependencies: Target module injection family, without inheriting its qualification
Auto Assembler family, without inheriting its qualification

implementation.requirement: Approve each route and baseline restoration contract

artifact.requirement: Identify route helper and SDK artifacts

host.requirement: Observe route, GUI dispatch, and target state

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove baseline restoration and residual-hook state

live: Baseline, set, read-back, timing sample, restore, disable, and target replacement
negative: Invalid value, helper failure, route mismatch, and target exit
cleanup: Prove reset/restore or report residual hooks

adoption_decision.reason: Local, CE-server, and callback routes must not share one promotion decision.

families.title: Generic hotkey registration

owner.sdk: Hotkey mapping, callback root, registration identity, and removal
owner.client: Chord choice and bounded asynchronous observation policy

host_prerequisites: Exact CE host and an observed non-conflicting fixture chord
Observed callback thread and registration result
Activation-scoped callback admission

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: A reversible chord and copied-event handler
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Registration outcome and copied event only
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Remove the registration, neutralize callback root, and prove post-disable inertness

families.evidence_gap: Historical Lua registration names do not prove callback threading, duplicate semantics, removal, or teardown in CE 7.7.

host.requirement: Observe chord handling and callback thread

live: Register, trigger, remove, disable, re-enable, and replace target
negative: Duplicate chord, handler throw, and stale callback

adoption_decision.reason: Hotkeys require an independent callback lifecycle contract.

families.title: Host timer creation and callback lifecycle

owner.sdk: Timer mapping, callback root, interval facts, and disposal
owner.client: Scheduling policy and bounded observation stream

host_prerequisites: Exact CE host and observed timer callback thread
Positive bounded interval
Activation-scoped component ownership

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Positive interval and copied tick handler
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Creation outcome and copied tick timestamps
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Disable, neutralize callback, free timer, and prove no post-dispose admission

families.evidence_gap: Historical component/timer implementation does not qualify interval tolerance, callback affinity, or cleanup ordering.

implementation.requirement: Approve timer lifetime separate from form lifetime

host.requirement: Observe callback thread and timer behavior

fixture: Interval validation and bounded stream behavior
live: Create, tick, dispose, disable, re-enable, and observe target change
negative: Invalid interval, creation failure, handler throw, and stale activation
cleanup: Wait past two intervals and prove no admission

adoption_decision.reason: Timers need their own component and callback cleanup proof.

families.title: Structure registry, inference, and target writes

owner.sdk: Structure object mapping, ownership facts, and target-operation boundaries
owner.client: Schema workflow, interpretation, and user-visible policy

host_prerequisites: Exact structure module and main-thread behavior
Observed object/list ownership
Authorized disposable target for inference or write slices
privilege_requirements: Explicit target-write authorization for element setters
No target authority for registry-only observation

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Bounded registry, definition, inference, or reversible write request
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied metadata or classified target outcome, never raw Lua structure handles
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Balance updates, remove temporary registry entries, destroy only with proved ownership, and restore bytes for writes

families.evidence_gap: Historical Lua structure handles and source mutators do not prove SDK ownership, main-thread use, inference accuracy, or write recovery.
dependencies: SDK-010 target identity refusal boundary for target-backed slices

implementation.requirement: Approve registry, definition, inference, and write slices separately

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove update, registry, graph, and byte restoration

fixture: Registry result, invalid index, and update-balance cases
live: Create/remove definition; separately infer and reversibly write fixture bytes
negative: Wrong arity, stale handle, unreadable range, and target change
cleanup: Prove no stale list entry, update state, or changed byte

adoption_decision.reason: Definition lifecycle, inference, and writes require independent decisions.

families.title: Auto Assembler validation, patches, and extensions

owner.sdk: Exact script mapping, disable-info ownership, callback ABI, and release outcome
owner.client: Script trust, explicit mutation policy, and recovery presentation

host_prerequisites: Exact Lua global shape and CE build
Observed target identity before apply and release
Authorized disposable target and reversible script
privilege_requirements: Separate host-self authorization; targetSelf is never implicit

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Trusted reversible script, targetSelf=false, and unique anchor/original-byte evidence
inputs_results_cleanup.result: A rooted CE disable-info owner or classified uncertain effect
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Use the retained disable-info once; preserve recovery data after false, error, or refusal

failure_modes: Observed identity mismatch or check-to-effect interval
families.evidence_gap: The existing SDK patch owner is source-indexed with a known target check-to-effect gap; no host qualification proves apply/disable safety.

implementation.requirement: Approve validation, reversible patch, and extension contracts independently

host.requirement: Observe Lua result, callbacks, and target effect

policy.requirement: Authorize exact script and target scope

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove disable-info release or report recovery required

fixture: Script parsing, disable-info ownership, and negative result handling
live: Apply, observe, disable, re-enable, and replace target
negative: Apply/disable false, Lua error, target exit, Lua reset, and double release
cleanup: Prove original bytes, symbols, and allocations are restored

adoption_decision.reason: Existing patch mechanics are not a blanket Auto Assembler support decision.

families.title: Module injection and remote execution

owner.sdk: CE interop, target allocation/thread ownership, timeout semantics, and factual outcomes
owner.client: Trust policy, operator consent, and bounded workflow result

host_prerequisites: Exact CE build, target architecture, and process incarnation
Trusted absolute artifact path/hash where a module is involved
A disposable target with a harmless bounded action
privilege_requirements: No inherited authority from patching or speedhack

inputs_results_cleanup.inputs: Target-compatible trusted module or bounded call description with positive timeout
inputs_results_cleanup.result: Copied completion/timeout/unknown-effect outcome; no remote pointer escapes
inputs_results_cleanup.cleanup: Release only confirmed-safe allocations; record module/orphan or uncertain execution state

families.evidence_gap: Historical injectDLL and remote executor paths do not qualify timeout cancellation, target ABI, unload, or resource ownership in the supported host.
dependencies: Auto Assembler family without inheriting qualification

implementation.requirement: Approve module injection and remote execution as separate contracts

artifact.requirement: Identify SDK and injected artifact identities

host.requirement: Observe exact global and target route

lifecycle_cleanup.requirement: Prove safe completion/release or report unknown effect

fixture: Path, bitness, timeout, and result-shape validation
live: Harmless action, completion, failure, cleanup, disable, re-enable, and target replacement
negative: Missing path, wrong architecture, remote exception, timeout, and target exit
cleanup: Prove allocation release and explicitly document any unremovable module

adoption_decision.reason: Injection, invocation, and host-local execution require separate authorization and contracts.

families.title: Bounded target-memory and file hashing

owner.sdk: Any CE mapping, bounded read, failure classification, and target identity fact
owner.client: Algorithm choice, path trust policy, and presentation

host_prerequisites: An approved bounded read contract
Observed target identity for memory hash
Authorized local file fixture for file hash

dependencies: SDK-010 target identity refusal boundary for memory hash

implementation.requirement: Approve memory and file hashing independently

host.requirement: Observe memory-read contract, not only a hash name

live_qualification.requirement: Review memory and file captures separately

policy.requirement: Authorize range and file path separately

live: Hash bounded memory and file, disable/re-enable, and replace target
negative: Unreadable range, missing file, unauthorized path, and target switch
cleanup: Prove no borrowed buffer or open file survives
